$comment: Chrome/Edge enterprise policy to force-install the BlissWork Activity extension on managed browsers and enrol each member. Linux: /etc/opt/chrome/policies/managed/blisswork.json (or /etc/chromium/policies/managed/). macOS: convert to a .mobileconfig / use your MDM. Windows: use windows-forcelist.reg instead. Replace __EXTENSION_ID__ (printed by pack-crx.sh) and the URLs. NOTE what is ABSENT: no IncognitoModeAvailability change and nothing that allows the extension in incognito — the shipped default excludes private windows, and this policy keeps it that way. There is also no way here to set captureAll/captureIncognito: those are not policy-controllable by design.

__EXTENSION_ID__.$comment: Per-member enrolment. Deliver a DIFFERENT token to each user's managed profile (via your MDM's per-user policy targeting) — the token is one (org, user), so one shared token would attribute everyone's browsing to a single person. apiBase is the same everywhere.
